properties.title: Dinosaurs Beneath the Waves
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya wades into the warm Caribbean water and looks beneath the waves.
Freya: Hello? Is anybody down there?
Narrator: A gigantic shadow glides underneath her.
Plesiosaur: Splooooosh!
Freya: A dinosaur!
Narrator: A friendly Plesiosaur rises from the water and gives Freya a giant splash.
Freya: You're very friendly!
Narrator: Something even bigger swims behind the Plesiosaur.
Mosasaur: Grrrrr!
Freya: You're friendly too, aren't you?
Narrator: The Mosasaur gives a happy little wiggle and sprays water into the air.
Freya: We need to get you both to the beach before the comet comes!

properties.title: The Seashell Necklace
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya collects the prettiest shells she can find.
Freya: This one is pink, and this one is purple!
Narrator: She makes a tiny necklace and holds it up proudly.
Plesiosaur: Splish!
Freya: You like it!
Narrator: The Plesiosaur nudges Freya gently toward the beach.
Freya: Okay! Let's go find the other dinosaurs!

properties.title: The Great Sea Race
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya climbs onto the Plesiosaur's back.
Freya: Ready, set, GO!
Narrator: The Plesiosaur zooms through the water while Freya laughs and holds on tight.
Mosasaur: Splash!
Narrator: The Mosasaur races alongside them, making enormous waves.
Freya: We're the fastest dinosaur team ever!
Narrator: Together they race back toward St. John Beach.

properties.title: Deep in the Jungle
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya follows a trail of enormous footprints into the deep jungle.
Freya: These footprints are HUGE!
Narrator: Leaves shake nearby.
Velociraptors: Chirp! Chirp! Chirp!
Freya: Tiny dinosaurs!
Narrator: A group of colorful feathered Velociraptors races around Freya in happy circles.

properties.title: The Giant Footprints
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya follows enormous footprints through the jungle.
Freya: Who could have feet this big?
Narrator: The trees part, revealing a giant friendly T-Rex beside a leafy Triceratops.
Triceratops: Munch munch!
T-Rex: Grrrrrr!
Freya: Don't worry! I'm here to help you!
Narrator: The T-Rex gives Freya a goofy smile.
Freya: We have to go to the beach. The comet is coming!

properties.title: Dinosaurs on the Beach
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya stays on the beach and searches between the palm trees.
Narrator: Suddenly, a giant Triceratops walks out of the jungle.
Triceratops: Munch munch munch!
Freya: Hi! You must be hungry.
Narrator: Freya gives the Triceratops some tropical leaves.
Narrator: Then several colorful Velociraptors race onto the sand.
Velociraptors: Chirp! Chirp! Chirp!
Freya: There are dinosaurs everywhere!
Narrator: A gigantic T-Rex appears behind them.
T-Rex: Grrrrr!
Freya: And you too!

nodes.title: What should Freya do with the dinosaurs?

properties.title: What should Freya do with the dinosaurs?
Triceratops Cuddle
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya walks right up to the Triceratops.
Freya: Can I give you a hug?
Narrator: The Triceratops lowers its enormous head.
Freya: You're very soft!
Narrator: Freya hugs the dinosaur's giant nose.
Triceratops: Mmmmm!
Freya: Now let's get everybody together!

properties.title: Velociraptor Parade
properties.text:
Narrator: The Velociraptors run in a circle around Freya.
Freya: Let's have a dinosaur parade!
Narrator: Freya marches down the beach while the Velociraptors follow in a colorful line.
Velociraptors: Chirp chirp chirp!
Freya: Everybody to the beach!

properties.title: T-Rex Taxi
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya climbs carefully onto the T-Rex's back.
Freya: T-Rex taxi!
Narrator: The T-Rex takes tiny careful steps along the beach.
T-Rex: Grrrrr!
Freya: You're a very good taxi.
Narrator: Freya can see dinosaurs gathering all around the island.

properties.title: The Dinosaurs Gather
properties.text:
Narrator: Dinosaurs arrive from the jungle, the water, and every corner of St. John.
Plesiosaur: Splooooosh!
Mosasaur: Splash!
Triceratops: Munch!
Velociraptors: Chirp chirp!
Parasaurolophus: Hoooooo!
T-Rex: Grrrr!
Narrator: Soon the entire beach is covered with happy dinosaurs.
Freya: Everybody's here!

nodes.title: How should Freya transform the dinosaurs?

properties.title: How should Freya transform the dinosaurs?

choices.text: Let the dinosaurs press it together

properties.title: Find the Magic Device
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya suddenly remembers the glowing device in her backpack.
Freya: Wait! I have my birdie machine!
Narrator: She holds the device up high.
Freya: Everybody, come close!
Narrator: Every dinosaur on the island gathers around Freya.
Freya: When the comet comes, we're going to fly away together!

properties.title: Rainbow Transformation
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya presses the giant rainbow button.
Freya: BEEP!
Narrator: A rainbow beam shoots across the beach.
Narrator: One by one, the dinosaurs transform into magnificent birds.
Triceratops: Tweet!
T-Rex: CAW!
Velociraptors: Chirp chirp chirp!
Narrator: The enormous comet reaches the sky above St. John.
Freya: Look!
Narrator: The comet suddenly bursts into a gigantic explosion of colorful fireworks.
Freya: It worked!
Narrator: The sky fills with sparkling stars, rainbow fireworks, and hundreds of happy birds.

properties.title: Everybody Press Together
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya holds the device while all the dinosaurs touch it together.
Freya: Everybody press!
Narrator: Hundreds of little dinosaur noses, paws, claws, and tails touch the glowing machine.
Narrator: BOOOOM! A rainbow wave sweeps across St. John.
Narrator: Every dinosaur transforms into a beautiful bird.
Freya: We did it together!
Narrator: At that exact moment, the comet explodes harmlessly into a spectacular fireworks show.
Narrator: The entire sky sparkles above Freya and her new bird friends.

properties.title: Birdies in the Sky
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya points the magical device toward the enormous comet.
Freya: Fly, little birdies!
Narrator: A rainbow beam shoots upward and surrounds every dinosaur.
Narrator: The dinosaurs transform into birds and immediately soar into the sky.
Narrator: The comet reaches the atmosphere and bursts apart into a gigantic fireworks celebration.
Freya: It's beautiful!
Narrator: The birds swoop around Freya in enormous sparkling circles.

properties.title: Tiny Birdie Dance
properties.text:
Narrator: Hundreds of tiny colorful birds land around Freya.
Freya: Dance with me!
Narrator: The little birds hop left, hop right, flap their wings, and spin in circles.
Narrator: Freya dances in the middle of them, laughing.
Freya: This is the best vacation ever!
Narrator: Fireworks sparkle above the beach as the tiny birds dance faster and faster.

properties.title: The Great Sea Bird Flight
properties.text:
Narrator: The giant sea birds swoop down toward the ocean.
Freya: Can I fly with you?
Narrator: A huge blue bird gently lifts Freya onto its back.
Narrator: They soar above the sparkling Caribbean Sea while fireworks reflect in the water.
Freya: We're flying!
Narrator: The sea birds circle the island in a beautiful glowing formation.

properties.title: Jungle Bird Adventure
properties.text:
Narrator: The colorful jungle birds fly toward the treetops.
Freya: Wait for me!
Narrator: Freya follows them into the jungle as they swoop between palms and giant flowers.
Narrator: The birds make a musical chorus with their calls.
Freya: You're making a jungle song!
Narrator: Fireworks flash through the leaves like colorful stars.

properties.title: The Biggest Bird
properties.text:
Narrator: The biggest bird of all lands gently beside Freya.
Freya: You are HUGE!
Narrator: The giant bird lowers one enormous wing like a staircase.
Freya: Up we go!
Narrator: Freya climbs aboard and rises high above St. John.
Narrator: Below her, every bird circles the island while fireworks explode across the sky.
Freya: I can see everything!

outputs.name: Explore the jungle with the birds

choices.text: Explore the jungle with the birds

properties.title: Beach Dance Party
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya returns to the warm sand.
Narrator: Every bird lands around her and forms a giant circle.
Freya: Everybody dance!
Narrator: The birds flap, hop, spin, and wiggle while Freya dances in the middle.
Narrator: The fireworks continue sparkling overhead.
Freya: I love birdies!
Narrator: The whole beach becomes one enormous happy dance party.

properties.title: Jungle Celebration
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya follows the birds into a sunny jungle clearing.
Narrator: The birds decorate the trees with glowing feathers.
Freya: It's like a jungle party!
Narrator: The birds sing while Freya dances between giant flowers.
Narrator: Rainbow fireworks shine through the leaves.
Freya: We can have adventures here forever!

properties.title: Flying Over the Island
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya flies high above St. John with her bird friends.
Narrator: Below them, the island glows beneath the stars.
Narrator: The ocean sparkles, the jungle sways, and fireworks fill the sky.
Freya: This is the most amazing thing I've ever seen!
Narrator: The birds fly in a giant heart-shaped formation around Freya.
Freya: Let's come back tomorrow!

properties.title: Vacation on St. John
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya is four years old, and she is on vacation in the beautiful Virgin Islands. It's her second time on the island and she's glad to be back.
Freya: Wow! The water is so blue! Even bluer than last time!
Narrator: But high above the island, something enormous is getting closer. It's darkening the whole sky.
Freya: Is that a giant glowing rock? A spaceship? A huge bird?
Narrator: It is a gigantic comet, streaking through the sky toward Earth. No one knew it was coming, but now it's almost here.
Freya: Oh no! We have to help everybody!
Narrator: Freya reaches into her backpack and pulls out a strange glowing device.
Freya: My magic birdie machine can turn dinosaurs into birds!

properties.title: The Dinosaurs Return
properties.text:
Narrator: The seasons turn, again and again, as Freya grows a little bigger every summer.
Narrator: She never stops visiting St. John, and she never stops watching the sky.
Narrator: Then one warm morning in 2026, something wonderful happens.
Freya: The birdies... they're glowing!
Narrator: One by one, the magical birds shimmer with rainbow light.
Triceratops: Munch munch!
T-Rex: Grrrrrr!
Narrator: Right before Freya's eyes, the birdies transform back into dinosaurs.
Freya: You're dinosaurs again! You came back!
Narrator: It turns out the magic device had one more secret all along - once the danger had truly passed, it could bring her friends all the way home.
Velociraptors: Chirp! Chirp! Chirp!
Freya: Welcome back, everybody! Let's go play!
Narrator: And so, in the summer of 2026, the dinosaurs of St. John came home to stay - safe, happy, and free, forever.

properties.title: The Year 3535
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya's story is told again and again, for a hundred years, then a thousand.
Narrator: The dinosaurs never forget the little girl who saved them, and they never stop growing - in numbers, in size, and in confidence.
Narrator: By the year 3535, the dinosaurs don't just live on St. John anymore. They live everywhere. And they are in charge of everything.
T-Rex: GRRRRRR! (Which, by now, means "Good morning, Earth!")
Narrator: Shiny dinosaur cities rise above the clouds, built from crystal and vines and a thousand years of careful engineering.
Narrator: And humans? Humans are the dinosaurs' favorite little creatures - fed the best snacks, walked twice a day, and cuddled whenever they want.
Triceratops: Munch munch! (Time for treats!)
Narrator: In the grandest city of all stands a statue of a four-year-old girl with a tiny backpack and a glowing device.
Velociraptors: Chirp chirp chirp!
Narrator: Every dinosaur, big or small, knows her name, and every dinosaur follows her very first rule, passed down for fifteen hundred years: always be kind to your creatures.
Narrator: Freya would be proud.

properties.title: Dinner in Cruz Bay
properties.text:
Narrator: Before heading back to celebrate, Freya and a few curious birds make a quick stop in Cruz Bay for dinner.
Freya: I'm hungry after all that dancing!
Narrator: A little restaurant by the harbor is grilling something smoky and delicious.
Freya: What's that yummy smell?
Narrator: It's BBQ, and Freya has never tried it before in her life.
Freya: Can I have a bite?
Narrator: She takes her very first taste of BBQ, and her eyes go wide.
Freya: Mmmmm! This might be the best thing I've ever eaten!
Narrator: Even the birds hop closer, curious about the smoky new smell.
Freya: Okay, NOW I'm ready to go back and celebrate!

properties.title: Happily Ever After
properties.text:
Narrator: The fireworks slowly fade into twinkling stars.
Narrator: Every bird gathers around Freya one more time.
Freya: Goodnight, birdies!
Narrator: The birds chirp a giant musical goodnight.
Narrator: Freya smiles as the moon rises over St. John.
Narrator: The dinosaurs are safe, the island is happy, and Freya has made hundreds of wonderful new friends.
Narrator: And tomorrow, there will be another adventure.

properties.title: The Dinosaur Song
properties.text:
Narrator: Freya follows a strange musical sound into a sunny jungle clearing.
Parasaurolophus: Hoooooo-oooooo!
Freya: That's beautiful!
Narrator: The Parasaurolophus plays a long musical note with its enormous crest.
Freya: I think your music could help everybody find the beach!
Narrator: The dinosaur calls again, and the sound echoes across the island.
Freya: Come on! Let's get everyone together!

Freya.info: A cheerful four-year-old girl on vacation in the Virgin Islands, wearing a colorful swimsuit, sun hat, and tiny backpack. She carries a mysterious glowing device that can transform dinosaurs into friendly birdies.

Plesiosaur.info: A huge friendly sea dinosaur with a long neck, gentle eyes, flippers, and smooth blue-green skin. It loves splashing and playing in the warm Caribbean water.

Mosasaur.info: A gigantic but friendly marine dinosaur with a broad toothy grin, dark blue scales, and a powerful tail. Despite its enormous size, it behaves like a playful puppy around Freya.

Triceratops.info: A chunky, friendly Triceratops with three rounded horns, a big frill, sturdy legs, and a curious expression. It enjoys eating tropical leaves.

Velociraptors.info: A group of small, energetic Velociraptors with colorful feathers, oversized curious eyes, and playful personalities. They run around the jungle like excited puppies.

Parasaurolophus.info: A tall, gentle dinosaur with a long curved crest, soft green skin, and a sweet personality. It makes musical calls that echo through the jungle.

T-Rex.info: A huge friendly Tyrannosaurus with tiny arms, enormous feet, bright expressive eyes, and a goofy smile. It tries very hard to be gentle around Freya.

Pterodactyls.info: A flock of colorful flying dinosaurs with broad wings and long beaks. They soar above St. John in enormous graceful circles.

Comet Birds.info: Hundreds of newly transformed dinosaurs, now magnificent birds of every imaginable shape, color, and size. They have feathers, wings, crests, tails, and bright joyful eyes.

St. John Beach.info: A beautiful Caribbean beach on St. John with turquoise water, warm white sand, palm trees, tropical flowers, and enormous views of the sky. The perfect place to watch the approaching comet.

Caribbean Sea.info: Warm crystal-clear Caribbean water surrounding St. John, filled with coral, colorful fish, sea grass, and mysterious shapes moving beneath the surface.

Deep Jungle.info: Dense tropical jungle on St. John, filled with giant leaves, vines, palms, flowers, mossy rocks, and shafts of golden sunlight.

Jungle Clearing.info: A wide sunny clearing surrounded by dense jungle. Tropical plants grow around the edges, while enormous dinosaur footprints cover the soft earth.

Comet Sky.info: A spectacular night sky above St. John filled with stars and a gigantic glowing comet streaking toward Earth, surrounded by brilliant colors and sparkling trails.

Future Earth.info: The whole planet, fifteen hundred years after Freya's vacation on St. John. Crystal dinosaur cities rise above the clouds, and humans live happily as the dinosaurs' beloved pets.

Cruz Bay.info: The bustling harbor town on St. John, lined with restaurants, boats, and the smell of delicious food drifting along the waterfront.

magic_bird_device.info: A small magical device belonging to Freya. It glows with rainbow-colored light and has a single large button covered in mysterious dinosaur-shaped symbols.

seashell_necklace.info: A little necklace Freya makes from beautiful pink, white, and lavender Caribbean seashells. It rattles softly whenever she runs.

glowing_feather.info: A shimmering feather that appears after a dinosaur touches Freya's magical device. It glows softly in rainbow colors.

knows_comet_is_coming.info: Freya knows that the enormous comet is coming toward Earth and that something magical needs to happen before it arrives.

knows_dinosaurs_can_fly.info: Freya has discovered that her magical device can turn dinosaurs into birdies so they can fly safely away from the comet.

tried_bbq_in_cruz_bay.info: Freya tried BBQ for the very first time during a dinner stop in Cruz Bay, and loved it.

Find the Dinosaurs.info: Freya must explore St. John and find all the dinosaurs before the comet reaches Earth.

Save the Dinosaurs.info: Freya must bring all the dinosaurs together on the beach and use her magical bird device to save them.

Join the Birdie Dance Party.info: After the dinosaurs become birds and the comet explodes into fireworks, Freya must choose which birdies to join and where to celebrate.
